description.value: Banter is a handmade ice cream shop housed in the Eddy at the Bridge Building along the Vedder River in Chilliwack, one of two Fraser Valley locations founded by Laura and Zach. The shop creates four brand-new seasonal scoops each month, many drawing on ingredients sourced from local Fraser Valley farmers and artisans. Touring cyclists can grab a scoop and continue on a river walk in a relaxed, community-focused riverside setting.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 40m; rack (5 spaces) at 51m; rack (12 spaces) at 52m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Chilliwack (CHWK) location at 45530 Vedder Mountain Rd with phone (604) 858-0359, matching OSM tags exactly. The site is clearly active with current 2025 seasonal flavours and online ordering, confirming the business is open. Takeout is confirmed by the walk-up scoop shop format and pint pre-orders; vegan options are confirmed by the '(V)' designation on flavours such as Mango listed on the front page.
concerns: OSM tags outdoor_seating=no, but the website states pets are welcome in outdoor spaces and references 'river walks featuring your favourite scoops,' suggesting some outdoor area exists even if structured seating is absent — minor discrepancy worth verifying on-site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active ice cream shop with confirmed address, phone, and website. A natural refreshment stop for touring cyclists along the Vedder River.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website marks select flavours with '(V)' (e.g., Mango listed on front page), indicating vegan options are available
